# The core idea

Most LLM-document workflows are RAG — knowledge gets re-derived per query.

# There are three layers

raw, wiki, schema. Raw is immutable; wiki is LLM-owned; schema is co-evolved.

# Operations

ingest, query, lint.

> the wiki is a persistent, compounding artifact
